insights.summary: An investor's post on X (13 Jul 2026) saying Vivid is targeting ~50% revenue growth in FY27, that more than half of revenue comes from data centres, that it won ₹50 Cr of data-centre orders in ten days, that it works with 6 of India's top-10 hyperscalers and plans to add the rest in 2-3 months, and that capacity triples to 22,500 units in 1-2 months. The post doesn't say where these figures came from; the 50% target is not in any company document we hold, so treat it as unconfirmed until the company states it.
